posts.name: twelveohone
posts.cooked:
Hey folks,

 

Recently had a game against this, and whew. Interesting match. I wanted to clarify how some things work.

 

Just for clarity, it says that traps start face up and whenever a trap would be discarded, shuffle it back in to the deck instead, and play the top card of the villain deck.

 

Most of it stemmed from Armed and Ready. We hit two traps that were on top of each other. We did the damage and went to shuffle the first one back in to the deck, would we pause there, and resolve the second one fully, then go back and finish resolving the first one, or does the act of shuffling the deck take precedence? I ask because the card seems to never leave the top of the deck, simply do its damage and then you start shuffling the deck.

 

Second question was, we ended up with nearly all of Amubscade's deck recycling in the trash, due to Knyfe. If we had done this, I assume once his deck got down to just the 4 bombs, they would go off infinitely and kill us all. Is this correct? I know cards normally stay in play until they finish resolving, but the challenge mode states shuffle the bomb back in before it states play another card....

 

This mode was brutal, regardless. We ended Ambuscade's first turn with the entire team at around 12 hp.

Phantaskippy: I agree that it likely never left the deck, but was concerned it may similar to revealed cards and played cards, which go into their own limbo zone briefly. It matters because it would mean extra plays and damage, and he gets so very many plays in challenge mode anyway. Armed and Dangerous is already a terrifying card  in Challenge, and if it turned out that back to back bombs trigger, it may become the most terrifying card in this game.
